family: The single total deterministic-field family defined by proof.md and family.py. At actual length N enumerate primes2<=k<=N, r=ceil(N/k) and r-1 with r>=3,k>r+1, m=min(N,rk), ignored p=N-m, and2<=t<r. Use d=H+E0+1 from disperser.md Sections12--13, B=t(t+3)/2<=d<m, and choose the minimum(4p+8d-4B-3,k,t,p) including the zero option(4N,0,0,0). Construct Q_k by the supplied deterministic prime-degree specialization of Shoup in proof.md Appendix A and irreducible_prime(k), ignore p actual input bits, and evaluate the descending-power order-t symmetric polynomial on the remaining m bits over F2[Z]/Q_k with zero padding. No field-polynomial bits or advice are inputs.
theorem: This ONE fixed total deterministic-field language is in uniform P, hence NP with empty witnesses. At EVERY actual integer N>=0 it satisfies C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(11488091/1000000)N^(4/5). At EVERY integer N>=2^20 it satisfies C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(2872021921/250000000)N^(4/5)+(6552747/1000000)N^(3/5)-(196601707/10000000)N^(2/5)+(733109/200000)N^(1/5)-37. Consequently liminf over ALL integer N of C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. The full field construction, affine degree, unrestricted B2 elimination and all-length prime/interval coverage are supplied. The adaptive adjacent-choice cut is a proof device; the family and integer selector are unchanged. No prior verdict is a premise. Furthermore, for EVERY real eta>0 there exists N_eta such that for EVERY integer N>=N_eta this SAME family satisfies C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(10*2^(1/5)+eta)*N^(4/5). In particular there exists N0 such that for EVERY integer N>=N0, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(11487/1000)*N^(4/5). Section11 supplies the analytic prime theorem and minimum-loss transfer; no explicit N0 is claimed.
